extension_description.message: Unofficial local study helpers for public JW.org pages. No telemetry or uploads; not affiliated with Jehovah’s Witnesses.

extension_mobile_description.message: Unofficial local highlights, notes, saved places, and exact links for public JW.org pages in Edge on Android. No telemetry.
